speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Move in, Alse, and keep your hem out of the green rushes. The floor is rushes, and the church is full. Count the Mayor's door before you sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two more than at Easter. They are servants, and they are not here for the psalm.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can hardly see my shoe for the green.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then stand on it, and leave the counting to us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have lost the place.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then find it, and do not tell the aisle why.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is the answer after the lesson, sir. You were not on the line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know I was not. Leave the place. I will not have it found for me.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren. This is the gift of tongues, and it is not a long matter.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: They spoke as the Spirit gave them utterance. One tongue, then another, and the hearer had his own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has the glass in his hand. He looks as if he means the one turning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He has looked so before. Hear him out before you praise a promise.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The gift was understanding, not noise. A dark saying is still a saying, if the room can bear it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Will he go to fourteen, sir? He never misses it at home.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hush. This is not the porch in March.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I set the glass down. One turning. You have had the gift.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He set it down. Mark me. I have never seen him set it down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One glass. That is the sermon.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: By order, and after Friday, a portion of the Homily against Disobedience and Wilful Rebellion.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The portion is read. Go to your dinners with it, and with no more of me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Out by our own door. We do not linger, and we do not collect a company on the way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am looked for at the Fields'. I will not come back through the north porch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The north porch is empty, sir. Whoever was there has gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Nothing was said, and nothing will be said on my stair. Come, Alse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing was said.
